AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness rr CROSS JOIN mission_factory_owner.c464_control cc CROSS JOIN mission_factory_owner.provider_authoring_runtime fr WHERE rr.singleton AND cc.singleton AND fr.singleton AND rr.revision_sha256='1c514d62805fa988e00e994789f23cc272a86cf021646fdbe086d1c43b1e0b03' AND cc.runtime_enabled AND NOT cc.authoring_enabled AND NOT fr.enabled) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM mission_factory_owner.provider_authoring_admissions)=2 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_factory_owner.provider_authoring_admissions aa WHERE aa.enabled OR aa.release_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM '1c514d62805fa988e00e994789f23cc272a86cf021646fdbe086d1c43b1e0b03' OR aa.location_id IS DISTINCT FROM '0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid OR aa.actor_user NOT IN('f0856d53-83a6-4de0-bc0c-12c87916e665'::uuid,'b4952ed5-5ce0-49c0-9f2b-8fd5dcd89b4b'::uuid)) AND ((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items w JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts nd ON nd.id=w.dispatch_receipt_id JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub ON ub.id=w.authority_receipt_id WHERE w.id='48e1bdcd-f044-be8c-1923-54d38e7e822c'::uuid AND w.master_session_id='ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9'::uuid AND w.kind='narration' AND w.state='claimed' w.id<>'48e1bdcd-f044-be8c-1923-54d38e7e822c'::uuid
  and not ((w.state='failed' AND w.result->>'schema_version'='mission-count-overflow-failure/1'
 AND w.result->'failure_codes'='["MISSION_INPUT_COUNT_OVERFLOW"]'::jsonb
 AND w.result->>'outcome_uncertain'='false' AND w.result->>'provider_calls'='0'
 AND w.authorization_id IS NULL AND w.dispatch_id IS NULL AND w.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND w.receipt_id IS NOT NULL
 AND w.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.result) AND w.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload)
 AND w.master_session_id='ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9'::uuid
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts d

 JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit cp ON cp.receipt_id=d.id AND cp.event_code='c8_count_success'

 AND a.details->>'receipt_id'=w.receipt_id::text AND a.details->>'result_sha256'=w.result_sha256
 AND a.details->>'source_window_id'=w.authority_receipt_id::text AND a.details->>'payload_sha256'=w.payload_sha256

 AND ct.producer='mission_generic_ai' AND ct.scope_id=w.master_session_id AND ct.source_id=d.id AND ct.call_no=2

 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts da WHERE da.receipt_id=d.id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations pa WHERE pa.receipt_id=d.id))) OR (w.master_session_id='ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9'::uuid AND w.state='failed' AND w.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND w.result->>'outcome_uncertain'='false' AND mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(w.authority_receipt_id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts d WHERE d.id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND d.status IN('success','fallback') AND d.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND d.dispatch_count=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls settled WHERE settled.source_id=d.id AND settled.scope_id=w.master_session_id AND settled.call_no=1 AND settled.state='settled' AND settled.charged_usd=d.charged_cost_usd))) OR (w.state='completed' and exists(select 1 from mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts d where d.id=w.dispatch_receipt_id and d.master_session_id='ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9'::uuid and d.status='success' and d.finalized_at is not null) and not exists(select 1 from mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts a where a.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id and (a.status<>'success' or a.finalized_at is null))) or (w.state='ready' and w.lease_id is null and w.dispatch_receipt_id is null
       and w.authorization_id is null and w.dispatch_id is null)
 or (w.state='failed' and w.authorization_id is null and w.dispatch_id is null
 and w.finalized_at is not null and w.receipt_id is not null
 and w.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload)
 and w.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.result)
 and w.result=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-pre-provider-failure/1',
 'work_id',w.id,'master_session_id',w.master_session_id,'event_id',w.event_id,'request_key',w.request_key,
 'revision',w.revision,'ok',false,'failure_code',w.result->>'failure_code','provider_calls',0,'charged_cost_usd',0)
 and w.result->>'failure_code' in('work_validation_failed','request_validation_failed')
 and exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.dispatch_admissions ad
 join public.master_v2_sessions ms on ms.id=ad.master_session_id
 join public.locations l on l.id=ms.location_id
 where ad.master_session_id='ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9'::uuid and ad.c7_budget_enforced
 and ad.c7_budget_qualification_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
 and ms.owner_kind='ai_service' and l.is_test and l.is_active)
 and exists(select 1 from mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts d
 where d.id=w.dispatch_receipt_id and d.master_session_id='ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9'::uuid and d.authority_receipt_id=w.id
 and d.request_key=w.request_key and d.event_kind='mission_generic_event'
 and d.renderer_version='mission-generic-runtime/1' and d.status='failed' and d.finalized_at is not null
 and d.dispatch_count=0 and d.charged_cost_usd=0 and d.upper_bound_cost_usd=0
 and d.lease_token_sha256 is null and d.lease_expires_at is null
 and not exists(select 1 from mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts da where da.receipt_id=d.id)
 and not exists(select 1 from mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations pa where pa.receipt_id=d.id)
 and exists(select 1 from mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit audit
 where audit.receipt_id=d.id and audit.event_code='generic_pre_provider_failed'
 and audit.details=jsonb_build_object('work_id',w.id,'receipt_id',w.receipt_id,
 'failure_code',w.result->>'failure_code','provider_calls',0,'charged_cost_usd',0,'result_sha256',w.result_sha256))))))
 and not exists(select 1 from public.combat_v2_sessions s where s.master_session_id='ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9'::uuid
  and (public.combat_v2_values_written(s.id) is distinct from false or combat_panel_private.uses_simulated_pools(s.id) is distinct from true))))) then raise exception 'C7_ADMISSION_PENDING_RESERVATION' using errcode='55000';end if;
 return case when TG_OP='DELETE' then OLD else NEW end;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.staff_journal_settlements_v1(p_session uuid, p_user uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;
BEGIN
 -- This private reader is called only from the already authenticated room projection.
 -- Settled collective publications are readable by each current Staff participant;
 -- they confer no owner, retry, claim, tick, provider or gameplay authority.
 IF p_session IS NULL OR p_user IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_sessions s JOIN public.locations l ON l.id=s.location_id
  JOIN public.master_v2_participants mp ON mp.session_id=s.id AND mp.user_id_snapshot=p_user
   AND mp.left_at IS NULL AND mp.engagement_state='attivo'
  JOIN public.characters ch ON ch.id=mp.character_id AND ch.user_id=mp.user_id_snapshot
  JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.id=p_user AND pr.role IN('admin','master')
  WHERE s.id=p_session AND s.owner_kind='ai_service' AND s.master_user IS NULL
   AND s.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid
   AND l.is_active AND l.is_test AND s.closed_at IS NULL AND s.suspended_at IS NULL
   AND s.stato='in_corso')
  OR mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_scope_v1(p_session) IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 WITH released AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT w.id AS work_id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,
   jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',w.master_session_id,
    'event_id',w.event_id,'request_key',w.request_key,'expected_revision',w.revision) AS request,
   sw.context->>'source_revision' AS source_revision,
   jsonb_build_object('source_window_id',sw.id,'source_revision',sw.context->>'source_revision',
    'reason',sw.superseded_reason,'audit_sha256',public.combat_v2_sha256(a.details)) AS release
  FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items w
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.id=w.authority_receipt_id
   AND sw.work_id=w.id AND sw.master_session_id=w.master_session_id
  JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts dr ON dr.id=w.dispatch_receipt_id
   AND dr.master_session_id=w.master_session_id AND dr.authority_receipt_id=w.id
   AND dr.request_key=w.request_key AND dr.status='failed' AND dr.dispatch_count=0
   AND dr.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND dr.charged_cost_usd=0 AND dr.upper_bound_cost_usd=0
  JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a ON a.receipt_id=dr.id
   AND a.event_code='staff_preprovider_request_retry'
   AND ((w.id='d460a7be-a3a2-4ad8-9d3b-d2e929f2947e'::uuid AND a.details->>'schema_version'='c1266-request-size-release/1') OR (w.id='f4f7185e-4aae-4edd-ac24-65f8dcfa36f5'::uuid AND a.details->>'schema_version'='c1266-turn-recovery-release/1'))
   AND a.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND a.details->>'source_window_id'=sw.id::text
  WHERE p_session='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid
   AND w.master_session_id=p_session AND w.id IN('d460a7be-a3a2-4ad8-9d3b-d2e929f2947e'::uuid,'f4f7185e-4aae-4edd-ac24-65f8dcfa36f5'::uuid)
   AND w.state='failed' AND w.kind='director' AND w.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
   AND w.receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND w.message_id IS NULL
   AND w.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.result)
   AND w.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload)
   AND sw.context->>'source_revision'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
   AND sw.superseded_reason='staff_preprovider_request_retry'
   AND mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(sw.id)

 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,
  jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',w.master_session_id,'event_id',w.event_id,'request_key',w.request_key,'expected_revision',w.revision),
  sw.context->>'source_revision',
  jsonb_build_object('source_window_id',sw.id,'source_revision',sw.context->>'source_revision','reason','staff_saved_director_application','audit_sha256',public.combat_v2_sha256(a.details))
 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items w
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.id=w.authority_receipt_id AND sw.work_id=w.id AND sw.master_session_id=w.master_session_id
 JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a ON a.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND a.event_code='c1266_saved_director_applied'
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b ON b.decision_work_id=w.id AND b.source_window_id=sw.id AND b.master_session_id=w.master_session_id
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.work_items writer ON writer.id=b.writer_work_id AND writer.master_session_id=w.master_session_id AND writer.authority_receipt_id=b.id AND writer.kind='narration' AND writer.state='ready'
 JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts dr ON dr.id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND dr.master_session_id=w.master_session_id AND dr.authority_receipt_id=w.id AND dr.request_key=w.request_key AND dr.status='success' AND dr.dispatch_count=1 AND dr.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
 WHERE p_session='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid AND w.master_session_id=p_session AND w.id='e366b9fa-54dc-4abd-8ba6-9ceee83be9a4'::uuid
  AND w.kind='director' AND w.state='failed' AND w.receipt_id='07366817-3bf6-4bad-8387-0a4c0d1804f7'::uuid
  AND w.dispatch_receipt_id='e9524086-1e03-42d8-866b-1c12eb77840a'::uuid
  AND w.result_sha256='d0a4266f89198307e8c9020af67b4d2b099edc1cbf20e0aea5b38d1b78fc8ea9'
  AND public.combat_v2_sha256(w.result)='674c8253e511750022b6d9b477383aed5743ffb2c9ceee7b35a0125c10ac6201'
  AND w.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload) AND sw.source_sha256=w.payload_sha256
  AND sw.role_ids=ARRAY['cc335f44-c921-4b63-931d-464a59592db2'::uuid,'458c16cc-e747-49f7-9303-c81dd43cfb82'::uuid]
  AND sw.context->>'source_revision'='a0ba47902e6746a13c24ebae4e360db2e56dd64abad23483c09ba64411e11e51'
  AND sw.superseded_at IS NULL AND sw.consumed_message_id IS NULL AND b.state='ready' AND b.message_id IS NULL
  AND b.payload=writer.payload AND b.payload_sha256=writer.payload_sha256 AND writer.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(writer.payload)
  AND a.details->>'schema_version'='c1266-saved-director-application/1' AND a.details->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text
  AND a.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND a.details->>'batch_id'=b.id::text AND a.details->>'writer_work_id'=writer.id::text
  AND a.details->>'result_sha256'=w.result_sha256 AND a.details->>'generation_http_calls'='0' AND a.details->>'failed_work_preserved'='true'

 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',w.master_session_id,'event_id',w.event_id,'request_key',w.request_key,'expected_revision',w.revision),
  sw.context->>'source_revision',jsonb_build_object('source_window_id',sw.id,'source_revision',sw.context->>'source_revision','reason','staff_unpublished_reinterpretation','audit_sha256',public.combat_v2_sha256(a.details))
 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items w
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.id='433ace05-5265-4aad-96a3-5567b6e3480a'::uuid AND sw.master_session_id=p_session
 JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a ON a.receipt_id=(SELECT dispatch_receipt_id FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=sw.id) AND a.event_code='staff_unpublished_reinterpretation'
 WHERE w.master_session_id=p_session AND w.id IN('433ace05-5265-4aad-96a3-5567b6e3480a'::uuid,'310493d3-92d2-4645-ba85-ab42f57dbf9d'::uuid)
  AND w.receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND w.result_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND sw.superseded_reason='staff_unpublished_reinterpretation'
  AND mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(sw.id)

 UNION ALL
 SELECT w.id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',w.master_session_id,'event_id',w.event_id,'request_key',w.request_key,'expected_revision',w.revision),sw.context->>'source_revision',jsonb_build_object('source_window_id',sw.id,'source_revision',sw.context->>'source_revision','reason','staff_saved_director_application','audit_sha256',public.combat_v2_sha256(a.details))
 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items w JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.id=w.id AND sw.work_id=w.id AND sw.master_session_id=p_session
 JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a ON a.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND a.event_code='c1266_saved_director_applied'
 WHERE w.master_session_id=p_session AND sw.superseded_at IS NULL AND sw.consumed_message_id IS NULL AND ((w.id='e76f31f2-eded-495e-9c5f-f03461c5cc3a'::uuid AND w.master_session_id='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid AND w.kind='director' AND w.state='failed' AND w.message_id IS NULL
 AND w.payload_sha256='f962403b87a5c6bf6930818e4d5655e57451d1adebbd404702f4a75ae7bcf03a' AND w.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload)

  UNION ALL
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','staff_tick','source_revision',t.source_revision),
   'request',rel.request,'work_id',rel.work_id,'receipt_id',rel.receipt_id,'result_sha256',rel.result_sha256,'release',rel.release)
  FROM released rel
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1 t ON t.master_session_id=p_session AND t.source_revision=rel.source_revision
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts pr ON pr.request_key=t.request_key
   AND pr.master_session_id=p_session AND pr.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id
   AND pr.result_sha256=t.result_sha256 AND pr.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(pr.result)
   AND (pr.result->'dispatch'=rel.request OR (rel.work_id='e76f31f2-eded-495e-9c5f-f03461c5cc3a'::uuid AND rel.release->>'reason'='staff_saved_director_application' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts rp WHERE rp.master_session_id=p_session AND rp.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id AND rp.request_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5('310493d3-92d2-4645-ba85-ab42f57dbf9d'::uuid,'mission-staff-unpublished-reinterpretation/1:ac9aedbd59dcb835d717f4ddb6ce195e3c2a9d640df576667290fa38b7e6cbbb') AND rp.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(rp.result) AND rp.result->'dispatch'=rel.request)) OR (rel.work_id='433ace05-5265-4aad-96a3-5567b6e3480a'::uuid AND rel.release->>'reason'='staff_unpublished_reinterpretation' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts original_successor WHERE original_successor.request_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(t.request_key,'mission-staff-no-dispatch-resume/1:'||t.source_revision) AND original_successor.master_session_id=p_session AND original_successor.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id AND original_successor.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(original_successor.result) AND original_successor.result->'dispatch'=rel.request)) OR (
    rel.work_id='e366b9fa-54dc-4abd-8ba6-9ceee83be9a4'::uuid AND rel.release->>'reason'='staff_saved_director_application'
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts retry_pr
     JOIN released origin ON origin.work_id='f4f7185e-4aae-4edd-ac24-65f8dcfa36f5'::uuid AND origin.source_revision=t.source_revision
     WHERE retry_pr.request_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(origin.work_id,'mission-staff-released-director-retry/1:'||t.source_revision)
      AND retry_pr.master_session_id=p_session AND retry_pr.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id
      AND retry_pr.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(retry_pr.result)
      AND pr.result->'dispatch'=origin.request AND retry_pr.result->'dispatch'=rel.request)))
 ), bounded AS(SELECT DISTINCT item FROM items ORDER BY item LIMIT 128)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('schema_version',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM released) THEN 'mission-journal-settlements/2' ELSE 'mission-journal-settlements/1' END,'master_session_id',p_session,
  'items',coalesce(jsonb_agg(item ORDER BY item),'[]'::jsonb)) INTO result FROM bounded;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mission_generic_dispatch_async_status_v1(p_user uuid, p_request jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE w mission_generic_owner.work_items; e jsonb;
 recover_session uuid;selector jsonb;recover_request jsonb;next_key uuid;depth integer:=0;status_proof jsonb;marker jsonb;marker_count bigint;
 tick mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1;progress mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts;
 source_window mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows;receipt mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts;
 recovery_none jsonb:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-async-recovery/1','status','none',
  'request',NULL,'work_id',NULL,'state',NULL,'receipt_id',NULL,'result_sha256',NULL,'kind',NULL,'retry',false,'provider_retry_allowed',false);
BEGIN
 PERFORM mission_ai_board_owner.service_only();
 -- Recovery is a distinct closed DTO on this service-only reader. It never claims work.
 IF p_request->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-async-recover/1' THEN
  IF p_user IS NULL OR NOT mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(p_request,ARRAY['schema_version','master_session_id','selector'])
   OR (p_request->>'master_session_id' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$') IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1266_ASYNC_RECOVERY_INPUT' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  recover_session:=(p_request->>'master_session_id')::uuid;selector:=p_request->'selector';
  IF selector->>'kind'='request' AND mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(selector,ARRAY['kind','request']) THEN
   recover_request:=selector->'request';
  ELSIF selector->>'kind'='staff_tick' AND mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(selector,ARRAY['kind','source_revision'])
   AND selector->>'source_revision' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN
   -- Same persisted ownership and receipt/hash bindings as the Staff tick producer.
   SELECT * INTO tick FROM mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1 t
    WHERE t.master_session_id=recover_session AND t.source_revision=selector->>'source_revision' AND t.actor_user_id=p_user;
   IF NOT FOUND OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles sp WHERE sp.id=tick.staff_user_id AND sp.role IN('admin','master'))
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_participants mp
     JOIN public.characters ch ON ch.id=mp.character_id AND ch.user_id=mp.user_id_snapshot
     JOIN public.profiles tp ON tp.id=mp.user_id_snapshot AND tp.role IN('admin','master')
     WHERE mp.session_id=recover_session AND mp.user_id_snapshot=p_user AND mp.left_at IS NULL)
   THEN RETURN recovery_none;END IF;
   SELECT * INTO progress FROM mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts pr WHERE pr.request_key=tick.request_key
    AND pr.master_session_id=recover_session AND pr.actor_user_id=p_user
    AND pr.result_sha256=tick.result_sha256 AND pr.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(pr.result);
   IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN recovery_none;END IF;
   IF (mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(progress.result,ARRAY['schema_version','master_session_id','state','dispatch'])
 AND progress.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-progress/1' AND progress.result->>'master_session_id'=recover_session::text
 AND progress.result->>'state'='needs_attention' AND progress.result->'dispatch'='null'::jsonb
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items healed 
 WHERE healed.master_session_id=recover_session AND healed.created_at<tick.created_at AND (healed.kind='director' AND healed.state='failed' AND healed.result->>'ok'='true'
 AND healed.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(healed.payload)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts healed_dr
  JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit healed_a ON healed_a.receipt_id=healed_dr.id AND healed_a.event_code='c1266_saved_director_applied'
  JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit healed_f ON healed_f.receipt_id=healed_dr.id AND healed_f.event_code='generic_finalized'
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches healed_b ON healed_b.decision_work_id=healed.id AND healed_b.master_session_id=recover_session
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows healed_s ON healed_s.id=healed_b.source_window_id AND healed_s.work_id=healed.id AND healed_s.master_session_id=recover_session
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.work_items healed_writer ON healed_writer.id=healed_b.writer_work_id AND healed_writer.master_session_id=recover_session AND healed_writer.authority_receipt_id=healed_b.id
  JOIN public.messages healed_msg ON healed_msg.id=healed_writer.message_id AND healed_msg.kind='fato' AND healed_msg.recipient_user IS NULL AND healed_msg.body=healed_writer.result->>'text'
  WHERE healed_dr.id=healed.dispatch_receipt_id AND healed_dr.master_session_id=recover_session AND healed_dr.authority_receipt_id=healed.id AND healed_dr.request_key=healed.request_key
   AND healed_dr.status='success' AND healed_dr.dispatch_count=1 AND healed_dr.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
   AND healed_a.details->>'schema_version'='c1266-saved-director-application/1' AND healed_a.details->>'master_session_id'=recover_session::text
   AND healed_a.details->>'work_id'=healed.id::text AND healed_a.details->>'result_sha256'=healed.result_sha256
   AND healed_a.details->>'batch_id'=healed_b.id::text AND healed_a.details->>'writer_work_id'=healed_writer.id::text
   AND healed_a.details->>'generation_http_calls'='0' AND healed_a.details->>'failed_work_preserved'='true'
   AND healed_f.details->>'work_id'=healed.id::text AND healed_f.details->>'receipt_id'=healed.receipt_id::text
   AND healed_f.details->>'result_sha256'=healed.result_sha256 AND healed_f.details->>'result_jsonb_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(healed.result)
   AND healed_b.state='published' AND healed_b.published_at IS NOT NULL AND healed_b.message_id=healed_writer.message_id
   AND healed_s.consumed_message_id=healed_b.message_id AND healed_s.superseded_at IS NULL
   AND healed_s.source_sha256=healed.payload_sha256 AND healed_writer.kind='narration' AND healed_writer.state='completed'
   AND healed_writer.payload=healed_b.payload AND healed_writer.payload_sha256=healed_b.payload_sha256
   AND healed_writer.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(healed_writer.payload)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_segment_publications_v4 healed_pub WHERE healed_pub.work_id=healed_writer.id AND healed_pub.message_id=healed_msg.id)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls healed_q WHERE healed_q.producer='mission_generic_ai' AND healed_q.scope_id=recover_session AND healed_q.source_id=healed_dr.id AND healed_q.call_no=1 AND healed_q.state='settled' AND healed_q.charged_usd=healed_dr.charged_cost_usd))))) THEN
    next_key:=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(tick.request_key,'mission-staff-no-dispatch-resume/1:'||(selector->>'source_revision'));
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts nr WHERE nr.request_key=next_key) THEN
     SELECT * INTO progress FROM mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts nr WHERE nr.request_key=next_key AND nr.master_session_id=recover_session AND nr.actor_user_id=p_user AND nr.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(nr.result);
     IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN recovery_none;END IF;
    END IF;
   END IF;
   IF tick.request_key='9e48a416-9261-4399-9e4e-a82b8a3d3a48'::uuid AND selector->>'source_revision'='24db5db8da7ede254e6d719b587c4fa04dce6b9d1c920396251adb85d0f6294c' AND (recover_session='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid AND mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_count_limit_v1(recover_session)='none'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1 bt JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts bp ON bp.request_key=bt.request_key AND bp.master_session_id=bt.master_session_id AND bp.actor_user_id=bt.actor_user_id AND bp.result_sha256=bt.result_sha256 AND bp.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(bp.result)
 WHERE bt.master_session_id=recover_session AND bt.request_key='9e48a416-9261-4399-9e4e-a82b8a3d3a48'::uuid AND bt.source_revision='24db5db8da7ede254e6d719b587c4fa04dce6b9d1c920396251adb85d0f6294c' AND bt.actor_user_id='b4952ed5-5ce0-49c0-9f2b-8fd5dcd89b4b'::uuid AND bt.staff_user_id=bt.actor_user_id AND bt.result_sha256='b27ed0db18a45d371931f015be0cd0fa060ed3f99b8d5843e8cbef45ecfbb2f8'
 AND mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(bp.result,ARRAY['schema_version','master_session_id','state','dispatch','reason_code']) AND bp.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-progress/1' AND bp.result->>'master_session_id'=recover_session::text AND bp.result->>'state'='paused' AND bp.result->>'reason_code'='MGPG_C7_RUN_BUDGET_STOP' AND bp.result->'dispatch'='null'::jsonb)) THEN
    next_key:=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(tick.request_key,'mission-staff-budget-only-resume/1:'||(selector->>'source_revision'));
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts nr WHERE nr.request_key=next_key) THEN
     SELECT * INTO progress FROM mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts nr WHERE nr.request_key=next_key AND nr.master_session_id=recover_session AND nr.actor_user_id=p_user AND nr.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(nr.result);IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN recovery_none;END IF;
    END IF;
   END IF;
   recover_request:=progress.result->'dispatch';
  ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1266_ASYNC_RECOVERY_SELECTOR' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
  LOOP
   IF selector->>'kind'='staff_tick' THEN
    -- The persisted own progress receipt is the acknowledgement. Missing/claimed work is not no_work.
    IF (mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(progress.result,ARRAY['schema_version','master_session_id','state','dispatch'])
     OR (mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(progress.result,ARRAY['schema_version','master_session_id','state','dispatch','reason_code'])
      AND progress.result->>'reason_code'='MGPG_C7_RUN_BUDGET_STOP' AND progress.result->>'state'='paused')) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
     OR progress.result->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-generic-progress/1'
     OR progress.result->>'master_session_id' IS DISTINCT FROM recover_session::text
     OR jsonb_typeof(progress.result->'state') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
     OR (progress.result->>'state' ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$') IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1266_ASYNC_RECOVERY_PROGRESS' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
    IF recover_request='null'::jsonb THEN
     IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_sessions m JOIN public.locations l ON l.id=m.location_id
      WHERE m.id=recover_session AND m.owner_kind='ai_service' AND m.master_user IS NULL
       AND m.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid AND l.is_active AND l.is_test
       AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_participants mp
        JOIN public.characters ch ON ch.id=mp.character_id AND ch.user_id=mp.user_id_snapshot
        JOIN public.profiles tp ON tp.id=mp.user_id_snapshot AND tp.role IN('admin','master')
        WHERE mp.session_id=m.id AND mp.user_id_snapshot=p_user AND mp.left_at IS NULL))
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items pending WHERE pending.master_session_id=recover_session
       AND pending.state IN('ready','claimed','authorized','provider_started','uncertain'))
     THEN RETURN recovery_none;END IF;
     RETURN jsonb_set(recovery_none,'{status}',to_jsonb('no_work'::text));
    END IF;
   END IF;
   IF NOT mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(recover_request,ARRAY['schema_version','master_session_id','event_id','request_key','expected_revision'])
    OR recover_request->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-generic-request/1'
    OR recover_request->>'master_session_id' IS DISTINCT FROM recover_session::text
    OR (recover_request->>'event_id' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$') IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
    OR (recover_request->>'request_key' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$') IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
    OR jsonb_typeof(recover_request->'expected_revision') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
    OR (recover_request->>'expected_revision' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$') IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1266_ASYNC_RECOVERY_REQUEST' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
   IF (recover_request->>'expected_revision')::numeric>9007199254740991 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1266_ASYNC_RECOVERY_REVISION' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
   IF selector->>'kind'='staff_tick' AND (progress.result->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-generic-progress/1'
    OR progress.result->>'master_session_id' IS DISTINCT FROM recover_session::text) THEN RETURN recovery_none;END IF;
   SELECT * INTO w FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items wi WHERE wi.master_session_id=recover_session
    AND wi.event_id=(recover_request->>'event_id')::uuid AND wi.request_key=(recover_request->>'request_key')::uuid
    AND wi.revision=(recover_request->>'expected_revision')::bigint;
   IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN recovery_none;END IF;
   next_key:=NULL;
   -- Follow only the two existing server-generated retry successors, never compute a new work.
   IF selector->>'kind'='staff_tick' AND depth<2 AND w.kind='director' AND w.id=w.event_id
    AND w.state='failed' AND w.finalized_at IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT * INTO source_window FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw
     WHERE sw.id=w.authority_receipt_id AND sw.work_id=w.id AND sw.master_session_id=recover_session;
    IF FOUND AND source_window.context->>'source_revision'=selector->>'source_revision'
     AND (source_window.superseded_reason='staff_failed_director_validation_retry' OR (source_window.id IN('d460a7be-a3a2-4ad8-9d3b-d2e929f2947e'::uuid,'f4f7185e-4aae-4edd-ac24-65f8dcfa36f5'::uuid) AND source_window.master_session_id='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid AND source_window.superseded_reason='staff_preprovider_request_retry'))
     AND source_window.consumed_message_id IS NULL AND mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(source_window.id) THEN
     next_key:=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(w.id,CASE WHEN depth=0 THEN 'mission-staff-released-director-retry/1:'
      ELSE 'mission-staff-db-context-retry/2:' END||(selector->>'source_revision'));
    END IF;
   END IF;
   IF selector->>'kind'='staff_tick' AND recover_session='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid AND selector->>'source_revision'='ac9aedbd59dcb835d717f4ddb6ce195e3c2a9d640df576667290fa38b7e6cbbb'
    AND w.id='433ace05-5265-4aad-96a3-5567b6e3480a'::uuid AND mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(w.id) THEN next_key:=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5('310493d3-92d2-4645-ba85-ab42f57dbf9d'::uuid,'mission-staff-unpublished-reinterpretation/1:ac9aedbd59dcb835d717f4ddb6ce195e3c2a9d640df576667290fa38b7e6cbbb');END IF;
   IF next_key IS NULL THEN EXIT;END IF;
   SELECT * INTO progress FROM mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts pr WHERE pr.request_key=next_key;
   IF NOT FOUND THEN EXIT;END IF;
   IF progress.master_session_id IS DISTINCT FROM recover_session OR progress.actor_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_user
    OR progress.result_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(progress.result) THEN RETURN recovery_none;END IF;
   recover_request:=progress.result->'dispatch';depth:=depth+1;
  END LOOP;
  -- Legacy receipt has no marker. A local journal, Staff role or readable work is insufficient.
  SELECT * INTO receipt FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts d WHERE d.id=w.dispatch_receipt_id;
  IF NOT FOUND OR receipt.master_session_id IS DISTINCT FROM w.master_session_id
   OR receipt.authority_receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM w.id OR receipt.request_key IS DISTINCT FROM w.request_key
   OR receipt.event_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission_generic_event' OR receipt.renderer_version IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-generic-runtime/1'
   OR receipt.request_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM mission_internal.fingerprint(recover_request)
   OR receipt.envelope_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(receipt.envelope)
   OR receipt.authority_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM receipt.envelope_sha256
   OR receipt.envelope->>'work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM w.id::text
   OR receipt.envelope->>'master_session_id' IS DISTINCT FROM w.master_session_id::text
   OR receipt.envelope->>'event_id' IS DISTINCT FROM w.event_id::text
   OR receipt.envelope->>'authority_receipt_id' IS DISTINCT FROM w.authority_receipt_id::text
   OR receipt.envelope->>'payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM w.payload_sha256
   OR receipt.envelope->>'definition_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM w.definition_sha256
   OR receipt.envelope->'revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(w.revision)
  THEN RETURN recovery_none;END IF;
  SELECT count(*),(jsonb_agg(a.details)->0) INTO marker_count,marker FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a
   WHERE a.receipt_id=receipt.id AND a.event_code='c1266_async_owner_v1';
  IF marker_count<>1 OR NOT mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(marker,ARRAY['schema_version','actor_user_id','work_id','request_sha256','envelope_sha256','provider_timeout_ms'])
   OR marker->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-generic-async-owner/1'
   OR marker->>'actor_user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_user::text OR marker->>'work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM w.id::text
   OR marker->>'request_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(recover_request)
   OR marker->>'envelope_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM receipt.envelope_sha256
   OR marker->'provider_timeout_ms' IS DISTINCT FROM '240000'::jsonb
  THEN RETURN recovery_none;END IF;
  e:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(w.id);
  IF e IS NULL OR (e->>'execution_context' IN('staff_mission','ordinary_mission')) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_sessions m WHERE m.id=w.master_session_id
    AND m.owner_kind='ai_service' AND m.master_user IS NULL AND m.closed_at IS NULL AND m.suspended_at IS NULL
    AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id=p_user AND p.role IN('admin','master'))
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_participants mp JOIN public.characters c ON c.id=mp.character_id AND c.user_id=p_user
      WHERE mp.session_id=m.id AND mp.user_id_snapshot=p_user AND mp.left_at IS NULL)))
   OR (w.kind IN('director','narration','choice')) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
  THEN RETURN recovery_none;END IF;
  status_proof:=mission_generic_owner.work_status(w);
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-async-recovery/1','status','owned','request',recover_request,
   'work_id',w.id,'state',status_proof->'state','receipt_id',status_proof->'receipt_id',
   'result_sha256',status_proof->'result_sha256','kind',w.kind,'retry',false,'provider_retry_allowed',false);
 END IF;
 IF p_user IS NULL OR NOT mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(p_request,ARRAY['schema_version','master_session_id','event_id','request_key','expected_revision'])
 OR p_request->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-generic-request/1'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1266_ASYNC_STATUS_INPUT' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT w FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items
 WHERE master_session_id=(p_request->>'master_session_id')::uuid
 AND event_id=(p_request->>'event_id')::uuid AND request_key=(p_request->>'request_key')::uuid
 AND revision=(p_request->>'expected_revision')::bigint;
 e:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(w.id);
 IF e IS NULL OR (e->>'execution_context' IN('staff_mission','ordinary_mission')) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_sessions m
 WHERE m.id=w.master_session_id AND m.owner_kind='ai_service' AND m.master_user IS NULL
 AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id=p_user AND p.role IN('admin','master'))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_participants mp
 JOIN public.characters c ON c.id=mp.character_id AND c.user_id=p_user
 WHERE mp.session_id=m.id AND mp.user_id_snapshot=p_user
 AND (mp.left_at IS NULL OR (m.closed_at IS NOT NULL AND w.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
 AND w.state IN('completed','failed','uncertain') AND w.receipt_id IS NOT NULL)))))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C1266_ASYNC_STATUS_SCOPE' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 -- Observation only. Terminal history access conveys no new claim, gameplay or provider permission.
 -- No overflow terminalizer, current Root/lease renewal, dispatch mutation, or publication mutation.
 RETURN mission_generic_owner.work_status(w);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mission_generic_room_state_v1(p_location uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare uid uuid:=auth.uid();m public.master_v2_sessions;r public.mission_run_state;vchoices jsonb;
 staff boolean;participant boolean;objective text;active boolean; uf_work mission_generic_owner.work_items;uf_processing jsonb;uf_rounds jsonb;uf_progress_key text;uf_state text;uf_marker jsonb;uf_review boolean;
 academy boolean;flow_state text;flow_publication uuid;role_diag jsonb;
 private_source_step text;private_pending boolean:=false;
 staff_tick_view jsonb:=NULL;st_revision text;st_tick mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1;st_receipt mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts;
 st_work record;st_source record;st_dispatch jsonb;st_next_key uuid;st_original_key uuid;st_owner boolean:=false;
 st_valid boolean:=false;st_released boolean:=false;st_blocked boolean:=false;st_resume boolean:=false;
 st_ack_predecessor uuid:=NULL;st_candidate_predecessor uuid:=NULL;
 st_depth integer:=0;st_state text;st_public_state text;st_recovery uuid;st_effective_id uuid;
 st_budget_a mission_generic_owner.dispatch_admissions;st_budget_g mission_generic_owner.provider_policy;st_budget_p record;
 mb_read_recovery boolean:=false;mb_mode boolean:=false; st_spent numeric;st_http bigint;st_bound numeric;st_cap_cost numeric;st_cap_http integer;st_budget_ok boolean:=false;
 opening_resume49 jsonb:=NULL;opening_claim_resume6 jsonb:=NULL;
 journal_settlements jsonb:=NULL;
 c26_count_view jsonb:=NULL;c26_driver jsonb:=NULL;c26_proof jsonb;c26_kind text;c26_revision text;c26_phase_kind text;
  nw_original_sha text;nw_original_key uuid;nw_mode boolean:=false;
begin
 if uid is null then raise exception 'authentication_required' using errcode='28000';end if;
 staff:=exists(select 1 from public.profiles where id=uid and role in('admin','master'));
 select s.* into m from public.master_v2_sessions s join mission_generic_owner.run_bindings b on b.master_session_id=s.id
 where s.location_id=p_location and s.closed_at is null and s.owner_kind='ai_service'
 and (staff or exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants p join public.characters c on c.id=p.character_id and c.user_id=uid
  where p.session_id=s.id and p.user_id_snapshot=uid and p.left_at is null)) order by s.created_at desc limit 1;
 if m.id is null then return null;end if;
 perform mission_generic_owner.assert_runtime(m.id);
 select * into strict r from public.mission_run_state where master_session_id=m.id;
 select sw.step_key into private_source_step from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches pending_batch
 join mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw on sw.id=pending_batch.source_window_id
 where pending_batch.master_session_id=m.id AND pending_batch.composition_kind='entry_png'
   AND pending_batch.state IN('preparing','ready') AND pending_batch.retired_at IS NULL AND pending_batch.message_id IS NULL
   AND pending_batch.encounter_id IS NOT NULL
 order by pending_batch.created_at desc,pending_batch.id desc limit 1;
 private_pending:=private_source_step IS NOT NULL;
 participant:=exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants p join public.characters c on c.id=p.character_id and c.user_id=uid
 where p.session_id=m.id and p.user_id_snapshot=uid and p.left_at is null);
 -- Quest uses its own native source (mission_id is NULL). No private context is emitted.
 academy:=mission_creation_owner.director_context(m.id,r.current_step_key) is not null
 or exists(select 1 from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources qs
   join public.mission_plan_versions pv on pv.id=qs.plan_version_id
   join public.mission_plans qp on qp.id=pv.plan_id
   join mission_generic_owner.run_bindings qb on qb.master_session_id=qs.session_id
   join mission_generic_owner.definitions qd on qd.id=qb.definition_id
   join public.locations ql on ql.id=qs.location_id
   where qs.session_id=m.id and qs.state in('prepared','opening_pending','uncertain','started')
    and m.mission_id is null and m.tipo='quest' and qs.location_id=m.location_id
    and qs.plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id and qp.source_kind='quest'
    and qp.quest_episode_id=qs.episode_id and qp.quest_source_sha256=qs.source_sha256
    and qd.id=qs.definition_id and qd.plan_version_id=qs.plan_version_id
    and qd.plan_sha256=r.plan_sha256 and qb.snapshot_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(qb.snapshot)
    and qd.definition_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(qd.definition)
    and ql.id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid and ql.is_active and ql.is_test);
 select public_objective into objective from public.mission_plan_steps where plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id
   and step_key=coalesce(private_source_step,r.current_step_key);
 if participant and not academy then vchoices:=public.mission_generic_choices_v1(m.id);
 else vchoices:=jsonb_build_object('choices','[]'::jsonb);end if;
 active:=m.stato in('preparazione','in_corso') and m.suspended_at is null and r.run_phase in('preparazione','in_corso');
 -- Public metadata only; no work payload, private intent, role or provider configuration.
 select uf_candidate.* into uf_work from mission_generic_owner.work_items uf_candidate
where uf_candidate.master_session_id=m.id
 and not exists(
   select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows superseded_role
   left join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches superseded_batch
     on superseded_batch.source_window_id=superseded_role.id
   where superseded_role.master_session_id=m.id
     and mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(superseded_role.id)
     and (superseded_role.work_id=uf_candidate.id
       or superseded_batch.writer_work_id=uf_candidate.id))
 and not (m.id='b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid
   and mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(m.id)
   and exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows superseded
     where superseded.id=uf_candidate.id and superseded.superseded_at is not null))
 and not (
  m.id='93d78313-abde-4087-9eb7-7b96bc0fa089'::uuid
  and m.location_id='6c737082-8fc7-4fd8-b246-30297a1ed1af'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.id='3076c471-37c5-438e-8f50-0a790b787e05'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.kind='choice' and uf_candidate.state='failed'
  and uf_candidate.encounter_id='deadfef6-5b16-4921-aa86-b86ffad6f2f2'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.step_key=r.current_step_key
  and uf_candidate.run_control_version=r.control_version
  and uf_candidate.payload->>'actor_id'='1f662f89-447a-4cd3-9873-a5953a0e0d91'
  and uf_candidate.payload->>'round_id'='44061137-17a3-43fa-9225-d29aaa26e58a'
  and uf_candidate.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(uf_candidate.payload)
  and uf_candidate.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(uf_candidate.result)
  and uf_candidate.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-pre-provider-failure/1'
  and uf_candidate.result->>'failure_code'='request_validation_failed'
  and uf_candidate.result->>'provider_calls'='0'
  and uf_candidate.result->>'charged_cost_usd'='0'
  and (select md5(prosrc) from pg_proc where oid='mission_generic_owner.enqueue_choice(uuid,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure)
      ='76a88f0e93752e1456c90d160a7a855d'
  and exists (
    select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub
    where ub.id='fbfc8e29-8724-4241-b2fe-22dbc17eb9e7'::uuid
      and ub.master_session_id=m.id and ub.encounter_id=uf_candidate.encounter_id
      and ub.state='preparing' and ub.entry_side='png'
      and ub.next_round_id='44061137-17a3-43fa-9225-d29aaa26e58a'::uuid
  )
  and not exists (
    select 1 from mission_generic_owner.work_items rw
    where rw.master_session_id=m.id
      and rw.dedupe_key=uf_candidate.dedupe_key||':recovery:'||uf_candidate.id::text
  )
  and not exists (
    select 1 from public.combat_v2_declarations d
    where d.round_id='44061137-17a3-43fa-9225-d29aaa26e58a'::uuid
      and d.actor_id='1f662f89-447a-4cd3-9873-a5953a0e0d91'::uuid
  )
 )
 order by (uf_candidate.state not in('completed','failed')) desc,
  case when uf_candidate.state not in('completed','failed') then uf_candidate.created_at end asc,
  uf_candidate.created_at desc,uf_candidate.id limit 1;
 if uf_work.id is not null then
  uf_state:=case when uf_work.state in('claimed','authorized','provider_started')
    and uf_work.lease_expires_at<=statement_timestamp() then 'uncertain' else uf_work.state end;
  uf_processing:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-processing/1',
   'work_id',uf_work.id,'event_id',uf_work.event_id,'request_key',uf_work.request_key,
   'revision',uf_work.revision,'state',uf_state,'created_at',uf_work.created_at,
   'finalized_at',uf_work.finalized_at,'message_id',uf_work.message_id,
   'request',jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1',
    'master_session_id',m.id,'event_id',uf_work.event_id,'request_key',uf_work.request_key,
    'expected_revision',uf_work.revision));
 end if;
 -- Freeze only identities/states needed to wake progress, never the clock. Include
 -- declarations because a completed defense may advance mechanics without a run transition.
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('encounter_id',uf_enc.id,'state',uf_enc.state,
  'rounds',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('round_id',uf_r.id,'phase',uf_r.phase,
    'state',uf_r.state,'report_id',uf_r.report_id,'narrated_at',uf_r.narrated_at,
    'declarations',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(uf_d.id,uf_d.state) order by uf_d.id)
       from public.combat_v2_declarations uf_d where uf_d.round_id=uf_r.id),'[]'::jsonb)) order by uf_r.round_no)
   from (select uf_round.* from public.combat_v2_rounds uf_round where uf_round.session_id=uf_enc.id
     order by uf_round.round_no desc limit 2) uf_r),'[]'::jsonb)) order by uf_enc.id),'[]'::jsonb)
 into uf_rounds from public.combat_v2_sessions uf_enc
 where uf_enc.master_session_id=m.id and uf_enc.closed_at is null
 and not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches hidden_batch
   where hidden_batch.encounter_id=uf_enc.id and hidden_batch.source_window_id is not null
     and hidden_batch.composition_kind='entry_png' AND hidden_batch.retired_at IS NULL and hidden_batch.state in('preparing','ready')
     and hidden_batch.message_id is null);
 uf_marker:=mission_generic_owner.unified_progress_marker(m.id);
 if private_pending then uf_marker:=jsonb_set(uf_marker,'{batch}','null'::jsonb,false);end if;
 uf_review:=coalesce((uf_marker->>'review_required')::boolean,false);
 if academy and m.stato='in_corso' and r.run_phase='in_corso' then
  select rw.publication_id into flow_publication
  from mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows rw
  join public.combat_v2_rounds cr on cr.id=rw.round_id
  join public.combat_v2_sessions cs on cs.id=cr.session_id
  where rw.master_session_id=m.id and rw.publication_id is not null
   and cs.closed_at is null and cs.state='in_corso'
  order by cr.round_no desc,rw.round_id desc limit 1;
  if flow_publication is not null then flow_state:='combat_started';
  else
   select ub.message_id into flow_publication
   from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub
   where ub.master_session_id=m.id and ub.step_key=r.current_step_key
    and ub.run_control_version=r.control_version and ub.state='published'
    and ub.route is not null and ub.encounter_id is null
   order by ub.published_at desc,ub.id desc limit 1;
   if uf_work.state in('claimed','authorized','provider_started')
or exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub
     where ub.master_session_id=m.id AND ub.retired_at IS NULL and ub.state in('preparing','ready','needs_review')
       and not mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(ub.source_window_id))
    or exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw
     where sw.master_session_id=m.id and sw.consumed_message_id is null
      AND NOT(sw.superseded_at IS NOT NULL AND mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(sw.id))
      and (m.id<>'b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid
        or not mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(m.id) or sw.superseded_at is null))
   then flow_state:='evaluating';flow_publication:=null;
   elsif flow_publication is not null and not exists(
    select 1 from public.messages role_msg
    where role_msg.location_id=m.location_id and role_msg.kind='say'
     and role_msg.recipient_user is null
     and role_msg.created_at>(select scene_msg.created_at from public.messages scene_msg where scene_msg.id=flow_publication)
     and exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants mp
      join public.characters c on c.id=mp.character_id and c.user_id=mp.user_id_snapshot
      where mp.session_id=m.id and mp.character_id=role_msg.character_id
       and mp.joined_at<=role_msg.created_at and (mp.left_at is null or mp.left_at>role_msg.created_at)))
   then flow_state:='new_scene';
   else flow_state:='waiting_roles';flow_publication:=null;end if;
  end if;
 end if;
 if private_pending then
  flow_state:='evaluating';flow_publication:=null;
  vchoices:=jsonb_build_object('choices','[]'::jsonb);
 end if;
 mb_read_recovery:=staff AND participant AND academy AND active
  AND p_location='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid AND m.id='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid
  AND m.stato='in_corso' AND r.run_phase='in_corso'
  AND mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_count_limit_v1(m.id)='none'
  AND mission_generic_owner.role_source_revision_v1(m.id)='24db5db8da7ede254e6d719b587c4fa04dce6b9d1c920396251adb85d0f6294c'
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1 pt JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts pp
   ON pp.request_key=pt.request_key AND pp.master_session_id=pt.master_session_id AND pp.actor_user_id=pt.actor_user_id AND pp.result_sha256=pt.result_sha256 AND pp.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(pp.result)
   WHERE pt.master_session_id=m.id AND pt.request_key='9e48a416-9261-4399-9e4e-a82b8a3d3a48'::uuid
    AND pt.source_revision='24db5db8da7ede254e6d719b587c4fa04dce6b9d1c920396251adb85d0f6294c'
    AND pt.actor_user_id='b4952ed5-5ce0-49c0-9f2b-8fd5dcd89b4b'::uuid AND pt.staff_user_id=pt.actor_user_id
    AND pt.result_sha256='b27ed0db18a45d371931f015be0cd0fa060ed3f99b8d5843e8cbef45ecfbb2f8'
    AND mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(pp.result,ARRAY['schema_version','master_session_id','state','dispatch','reason_code'])
    AND pp.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-progress/1' AND pp.result->>'master_session_id'=m.id::text
    AND pp.result->>'state'='paused' AND pp.result->>'reason_code'='MGPG_C7_RUN_BUDGET_STOP' AND pp.result->'dispatch'='null'::jsonb);
 IF academy AND (mission_public_owner.role_capture_scope_v1(m.id) OR mb_read_recovery)
 
THEN
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
    WHERE c.master_session_id=m.id) THEN
    role_diag:=mission_generic_owner.role_flow_status_v1(m.id,uid);
  ELSE
    role_diag:=mission_generic_owner.role_status_snapshot_v1(m.id,uid,flow_state,uf_processing,uf_review);
  END IF;
  IF m.id='b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid
    AND role_diag IS NOT NULL THEN
    role_diag:=role_diag||jsonb_build_object('flow_reason','review_required',
      'next_actor','staff','flow_detail',null);
  END IF;
END IF;
  -- C1266: new finite source opt-in, proved from server start/admission, not a client state heuristic.
  IF staff AND participant AND p_location='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid THEN
   c26_proof:=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_admissions_v1 ma WHERE ma.master_session_id=m.id) THEN mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_scope_v1(m.id) ELSE mission_generic_owner.c1266_clean_staff_admission_v1(m.id,true,false) END;
  END IF;
  IF c26_proof IS NOT NULL THEN
   c26_revision:=mission_generic_owner.role_source_revision_v1(m.id);
   SELECT st.kind INTO c26_phase_kind FROM public.mission_plan_steps st
    WHERE st.plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id AND st.step_key=coalesce(private_source_step,r.current_step_key);
   c26_kind:='none';
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_admissions_v1 ma WHERE ma.master_session_id=m.id) AND role_diag IS NULL THEN c26_revision:=NULL;END IF;
   -- Native is the currently bound mechanical FSM with a published native entry/window.
   -- No work is required: this includes gathering PG declarations/defenses after a Fato.
   IF NOT private_pending AND EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.encounters ee
    JOIN public.combat_v2_sessions cs ON cs.id=ee.encounter_id AND cs.master_session_id=m.id
    JOIN public.mission_plan_steps ps ON ps.plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id AND ps.step_key=ee.step_key AND ps.kind='mechanical'
    JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds cr ON cr.session_id=cs.id
    JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows rw ON rw.round_id=cr.id AND rw.master_session_id=m.id
    JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub ON ub.id=rw.batch_id AND ub.master_session_id=m.id
    JOIN public.messages pubmsg ON pubmsg.id=rw.publication_id AND pubmsg.id=ub.message_id
     AND pubmsg.kind='fato' AND pubmsg.recipient_user IS NULL AND pubmsg.location_id=p_location
    WHERE ee.master_session_id=m.id AND ee.step_key=r.current_step_key AND ee.run_control_version=r.control_version
     AND cs.closed_at IS NULL AND cs.state NOT IN('chiuso','annullato') AND ub.state='published') THEN
    c26_kind:='native';
   ELSIF c26_phase_kind='narrative' AND active
    AND c26_revision ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND role_diag->>'source_revision'=c26_revision
    AND (mission_public_owner.role_capture_scope_v1(m.id) OR mb_read_recovery) THEN
    -- Includes legitimate ready_to_evaluate with no work: kind follows the narrative FSM, not absence of a job.
    c26_kind:='tick';
   END IF;
   -- A qualified manual scene without a role cursor keeps the existing
   -- read-only fallback revision. This does not grant a tick or create a cursor.
   IF c26_kind='none' AND c26_revision IS NULL
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_admissions_v1 ma WHERE ma.master_session_id=m.id)
    AND role_diag->>'source_revision' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN
    c26_revision:=role_diag->>'source_revision';
   END IF;
  END IF;
 -- C1264 AGG2: read-only receipt summary, confined to the existing protected scene.
 IF (m.id='ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9'::uuid OR (c26_proof IS NOT NULL AND c26_kind='tick'))
  AND p_location='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid AND staff AND participant
  AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_admissions_v1 ma WHERE ma.master_session_id=m.id) OR uid IN('f0856d53-83a6-4de0-bc0c-12c87916e665'::uuid,'b4952ed5-5ce0-49c0-9f2b-8fd5dcd89b4b'::uuid))
  AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.flow_staff_sessions f WHERE f.master_session_id=m.id AND f.enabled) OR (m.id='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid AND mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_count_limit_v1(m.id)='none'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1 bt JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts bp ON bp.request_key=bt.request_key AND bp.master_session_id=bt.master_session_id AND bp.actor_user_id=bt.actor_user_id AND bp.result_sha256=bt.result_sha256 AND bp.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(bp.result)
 WHERE bt.master_session_id=m.id AND bt.request_key='9e48a416-9261-4399-9e4e-a82b8a3d3a48'::uuid AND bt.source_revision='24db5db8da7ede254e6d719b587c4fa04dce6b9d1c920396251adb85d0f6294c' AND bt.actor_user_id='b4952ed5-5ce0-49c0-9f2b-8fd5dcd89b4b'::uuid AND bt.staff_user_id=bt.actor_user_id AND bt.result_sha256='b27ed0db18a45d371931f015be0cd0fa060ed3f99b8d5843e8cbef45ecfbb2f8'
 AND mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(bp.result,ARRAY['schema_version','master_session_id','state','dispatch','reason_code']) AND bp.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-progress/1' AND bp.result->>'master_session_id'=m.id::text AND bp.result->>'state'='paused' AND bp.result->>'reason_code'='MGPG_C7_RUN_BUDGET_STOP' AND bp.result->'dispatch'='null'::jsonb)))
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.locations l WHERE l.id=p_location AND l.is_test AND l.is_active)
  AND role_diag->>'source_revision' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  AND role_diag->>'source_revision'=mission_generic_owner.role_source_revision_v1(m.id) THEN
  st_revision:=role_diag->>'source_revision';st_state:='absent';
  SELECT * INTO st_tick FROM mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1 t

Il suo uso manuale non richiede una task dell’assistente, una prenotazione `staff:room`, una review ripetuta, controlli manuali prima di ogni gesto, conferme procedurali o rinnovi di finestre temporali. Questi passaggi non devono diventare condizioni per accedere alla stanza, scegliere una prova o proseguirla. La procedura di coordinamento degli assistenti non attribuisce loro un’esclusiva nei confronti di Antonello.

Decisione permanente di Antonello, recepita il 24/10/2026: nei suoi collaudi manuali nella Staff Test Room non si applicano tetti numerici al numero di chiamate IA, finché la spesa resta entro i budget economici autorizzati. Chiamate, token e costi continuano a essere registrati; i budget monetari e i limiti per richiesta non vengono aumentati o azzerati. Autenticazione, autorizzazioni Staff, isolamento server delle risorse reali, idempotenza e audit restano attivi. Le campagne eseguite dall’assistente mantengono scope, chiamate, token, spesa e durata finiti: questa decisione non concede all’assistente chiamate illimitate. Le finestre operative dell’assistente non sono scadenze da rinnovare per l’uso manuale di Antonello. Eventuali blocchi tecnici vanno corretti nel loro scope senza trasferire all’utente checklist o richieste ripetute. L’identità autenticata condivisa non dimostra da sola se il gesto sia umano o automatizzato; l’assistente resta responsabile del proprio limite operativo.

L’assistente coordina soltanto il proprio lavoro: non occupa il browser o la Staff mentre Antonello li usa, non avvia prove o retry autonomi per suo conto e interrompe la propria automazione quando viene richiesta la stanza libera. Eventuali lavorazioni proprie pendenti si risolvono con un esito autorevole e audit conservato, senza cancellare lo storico, resettare i contatori o modificare scene altrui. Il metodo non attesta che la liberazione tecnica sia già avvenuta.

Questa decisione prevale sulle prescrizioni di prenotazione, finestre e verifiche preliminari riferite all’uso manuale della Staff. Restano distinti lo sviluppo dell’assistente, le modifiche DB/Edge/client, i deploy e l’apertura pubblica: continuano a seguire i mandati e i controlli pertinenti. L’uso manuale non è una dichiarazione automatica di collaudo positivo o di prodotto aperto agli utenti.

## Cosa consegna ogni task
- `SCHEDA.md` del cantiere aggiornata; stato nella prima riga: proposto / in lavoro / applicato inerte / in uso / chiuso / parcheggiato.
- `HANDOFF.md` sovrascritto nel formato: TASK-ID · Scope toccato · Contratti usati/modificati · Decisioni prese / OPEN · Prove eseguite e risultato · Rischi o regressioni da verificare · Passaggio richiesto al PM.
- Una riga in `STORICO.md`: data · revisione · una frase · esito.
- Se ha cambiato lo stato operativo (cron acceso/spento, flag, gate, versione Edge, migrazione a registro): la riga corrispondente in `dossier/aree/<AREA>.md` §Stato vivo e, per le migrazioni, in `dossier/aree/PIATTAFORMA.md`. Una decisione scritta solo nell'handoff non esiste.

## Limiti
- Al massimo TRE cantieri «in lavoro». Se sono tre, il task nuovo non parte: si segnala al PM.
- «In uso» lo dichiara solo Antonello. «Chiuso» e «parcheggiato» spostano la cartella intera in `archivio/`. Un cantiere «applicato inerte» da più di sette giorni senza una data di prova diventa «parcheggiato» nel tabellone.
- Un file, un owner alla volta. Se un file che stai per scrivere è cambiato da quando l'hai letto, fermati: c'è un'altra sessione.
- Nessun apply a database senza review indipendente pertinente `0/0/0`, baseline verificata e mandato esplicito. Per le tecniche vale il mandato permanente del 10/09 descritto sotto: il PM identifica versione, operazioni e perimetro del rilascio già autorizzato, senza chiedere nuove conferme di procedura. Per gli altri lavori restano le autorizzazioni nominate e distinte di apply, consumer, Edge, enable, dati, sessioni e apertura.

## Metodo di avanzamento e QA empirico
**Decisione permanente Antonello · 23/09/2026:** per tutti i nuovi incarichi e le riprese, sviluppo funzionale e collaudo esclusivamente nella **Staff Test Room**, riusando la simulazione e i percorsi reali. Docker, PostgreSQL locali, fixture ricreate, banchi alternativi e branch QA escono dal percorso di sviluppo/verifica; non sostituire Docker con un altro banco locale. La preparazione dei sorgenti e i controlli statici/sintattici senza esecuzione di gameplay o DB restano consentiti e precedono la review. La Test Room utenti non è una seconda tappa obbligatoria e non viene cancellata o disattivata da questa decisione. Questa regola sostituisce le precedenti procedure Docker/branch del 09/09 e l'obbligo di collaudo/allineamento di entrambe le stanze del 06/09.
- Prima si completa un candidato coerente end-to-end sui requisiti e sulle invarianti conosciute; non si tenta di prevedere per ore ogni possibile difetto narrativo o di interazione.
- **Tecniche — procedura permanente ratificata da Antonello il 10/09/2026:** preparazione del codice e dei consumer → pubblicazione riservata nella Staff Test Room sul sito → collaudo delle funzionalità reali → correzione dei difetti osservati → apertura all'utenza appena il collaudo è positivo. Si riusa la simulazione già esistente, che non sottrae risorse alle schede dei PG; non si costruiscono un nuovo sistema protettivo, banchi locali o ambienti fittizi come passaggio di questo processo.
- Per le tecniche non sono prerequisiti Docker, ricreazione di fixture, campagne locali, matrice locale completa o contatori di cinque correzioni/cinque controverifiche dei vecchi banchi. Prima del rilascio riservato restano i controlli statici del codice e la review indipendente pertinente, il confronto con la baseline pubblicata, i pin, i permessi, la corretta composizione dei delta condivisi e una recovery conservativa che preservi dati e storico. Un difetto concreto di installazione o sicurezza si corregge prima dell'operazione interessata; non si trasforma in una nuova campagna funzionale locale obbligatoria.
- Il collaudo delle tecniche usa i normali percorsi del sito e la stessa simulazione delle Test Room, verificando le funzioni ordinarie **con e senza Master** e le interazioni realmente previste dalla tecnica. Non limitare globalmente il prodotto alla sola prova 1vs1 o togliere il supervisore dalla scena per evitare un errore. L'Esame resta escluso dai casi delle tecniche di clan; le sue regole di prodotto non cambiano; anche il suo collaudo segue la Staff unica del 23/09.
- I difetti emersi sul sito si raccolgono per causa, si correggono nel mandato e si riverificano nel percorso reale interessato, con le sole regressioni pertinenti. Si termina alla verifica positiva, senza ricertificazioni complete artificiali né nuove conferme per ogni correzione. Si conservano comunque le evidenze e i conteggi storici; non si riaprono o rinominano banchi per prolungarne i cicli.
- Il mandato del 10/09 autorizza anche l'apertura all'utenza delle tecniche collaudate positivamente nel perimetro concordato, senza una nuova conferma di procedura. Il PM registra versione, disponibilità iniziale effettivamente riservata, esito del sito e apertura. Un requisito o una superficie nuova richiedono invece una decisione di scope; un collaudo parziale non autorizza a dichiarare riusciti percorsi non provati.
- Prima di ogni sessione di collaudo eseguita dall’assistente si fissano scope, casi necessari, chiamate, token e tempo; le chiamate ai provider sono reali e limitate. Raggiunto un limite si conservano gli esiti e si consegna lo stato, senza ampliare le prove durante l'esecuzione. Errore di sicurezza, accesso non autorizzato o effetto su risorse reali fermano la prova interessata; niente bypass, impersonazione SQL o ripristino successivo usato come sostituto dell'isolamento.
- Il QA usa prioritariamente casi reali già conclusi e autorizzati — per l'Esame, gli esami già svolti — come corpus sanitizzato e immutabile. Non si copiano nei referti PII o testi completi delle role. Si correggono contratti, autorità, shape, validatori o architettura; non il solo testo di una fixture. I fatti meccanici restano server-side e immutabili, mentre il modello lavora nello spazio narrativo autorizzato.
- Per i lavori estranei al flusso tecniche restano i gate della sezione database, la revisione aggregata e i casi pertinenti giocati nella sola Staff Test Room; nessun percorso Docker/branch. Un caso rosso blocca il relativo rilascio ma non interrompe gli altri casi autorizzati, salvo rischio dati/sicurezza, superamento del budget o mutazione non prevista. Niente retry per cercare casualmente un verde.
- **Budget di revisione vincolante — aggiornato da Antonello il 09/09/2026:** per le candidate fuori dal flusso tecniche del 10/09 sono ammessi un passaggio indipendente iniziale, fino a **cinque correzioni aggregate** dei finding e fino a **cinque controverifiche**. Il conteggio è cumulativo sulla stessa candidata e comprende i passaggi già eseguiti: rinomine, riprese o nuovi incarichi non lo azzerano. Dopo ogni aggregata si congela la revisione, si esegue la matrice completa prevista e si raccoglie un unico referto indipendente; niente micro-correzioni durante il dialogo col reviewer né nuovi esempi esplorativi fuori dalla matrice fissata. Un esito rosso intermedio permette di proseguire autonomamente con l’aggregata successiva entro il limite e il mandato esistente, senza chiedere una conferma per ogni passaggio. Si termina appena la qualifica è verde; se la quinta controverifica è ancora rossa, il ciclo torna al PM senza ulteriori patch o rinomina per ripartire. Budget di casi/chiamate/token/tempo fissati prima di ciascuna campagna, isolamento, stop per P0/rischio dati e gate di produzione restano obbligatori. La modifica del limite non riapre automaticamente task archiviate o cantieri storici fuori dal mandato corrente.
- L'eventuale rigenerazione automatica è ammessa soltanto se prevista dal contratto del prodotto e va misurata separatamente dal successo al primo tentativo.

## Flusso database e rilascio controllato
- **Percorso unico:** contratto → candidata integrata DB/Edge/UI/configurazione/recovery → controlli statici e review indipendente pertinente `0/0/0` → preflight vivo readonly → apply/deploy autorizzati con disponibilità iniziale riservata alla Staff → prova giocata nella Staff Test Room → correzioni pertinenti → apertura nello scope autorizzato → consegna. Docker, DB locali e branch QA non sono passaggi del percorso.
- **Prima dell'installazione:** confrontare corpi, schema, firme, vincoli, permessi, versioni e baseline pubblicata; controllare sintassi dell'intero installer, composizione dei delta e recovery che preservi dati/storico. Un controllo lessicale non certifica l'eseguibilità né la sicurezza SQL. Non usare l'apply in produzione per scoprire se una migrazione è installabile: un difetto concreto non risolto blocca quell'operazione.
- **Versione integrata:** una sola identità per contratti, migrazione/hash DB, bundle Edge, commit/build client, configurazione e scenario Staff. La review deve coprire la composizione effettiva. Al drift rigenerare il delta minimo; non cambiare solo pin né reinstallare corpi arretrati.
- **Gate e budget:** fuori dalle tecniche restano review iniziale, fino a cinque correzioni aggregate e cinque controverifiche cumulative, salvo eccezione esplicita già ricevuta per la medesima candidata. La nuova procedura non azzera i conteggi. Casi, chiamate, token e tempo fissati prima della sessione; fermarsi al limite. Apply, deploy, enable e apertura sono operazioni distinte da identificare nel mandato; se già autorizzate non chiedere nuove conferme di procedura.
- **Rischi residui:** owner e reviewer indicano quali rischi sono coperti staticamente e quali nella Staff, inclusi Auth, RLS, Storage, Realtime e provider reali. Un rischio significativo non coperto resta un limite esplicito del rilascio; nessun nuovo banco o branch implicito. Le prove distruttive, le richieste SQL mutanti di test e le fault injection non si trasferiscono in produzione dopo la rimozione di Docker.
- **Protezione e rilascio:** mantenere riserva server effettiva, schede reali e scene altrui intatte. Per le tecniche resta autorizzata l'apertura dopo collaudo positivo nel mandato del 10/09. Per gli altri lavori vale l'autorizzazione specifica di rilascio e apertura, inclusa quella del mandato Combat/Regia del 23/09. Chiudere solo le prove proprie, conservare storico e verificare risorse e sessioni residue.
- Nessun secret, password, token, chiave o URL credenziale va letto, stampato o depositato nei file.
